items.name: Zoom Slides
items.tagline: Turn your Zoom meetings into ready-to-present slides
items.description: Zoom Slides is an AI-powered presentation maker that turns your meetings, documents, and ideas into polished, editable decks. Instead of starting from a blank slide, let Zoom AI turn meeting transcripts and summaries into structured presentations with professional layouts, visuals, and speaker notes. Refine content with AI, collaborate with teammates, and export to PowerPoint. Your meeting ends, and your presentation is already taking shape.

items.name: Boost.space AgentOS
items.tagline: One operating system for all your AI agents
items.description: Build your agent-driven company with specialized agents that share context, skills, and tools. Deploy, control, manage and chat or talk to your agents with access to more than 1,400 AI models and access to more than 1,500 tools you already use.

items.name: readywhen
items.tagline: Your personal assistant that lives in email around the clock
items.description: readywhen is the personal assistant on email. Email it a job, the same way you'd email a good assistant. It writes the follow-up, sends it from your email when you reply "send", then watches for the answer. Ask what you're waiting on. Nothing goes out without your OK. Just email assistant@readywhen.ai to get started. No account setup needed.

items.name: OpenBot
items.tagline: Grok Bot alternative: self-host, fully customize, any stack
items.description: Build your own enterprise-ready agent workspace that's modular and self-hostable. Designed with a clean architecture and built-in governance. Bring any agent- then choose the models, tools, and infra they run on. Use as-is, white-label it, or deeply customize it.

items.name: OpenFrame
items.tagline: AI agents that run your IT. You approve every fix.
items.description: OpenFrame gives small IT teams two AI agents to handle the work that never ends. Mingo patches devices, fixes issues, and handles routine technical tasks, with every change approved by your admin. Fae answers employee IT requests so your team can focus without constant interruptions. A weekly report shows leadership what got done. Endpoint management, AI agents, and IT support in one platform for $1 per device.

items.name: Cal.com v7
items.tagline: Cal.com now has events, discover, an assistant + more
items.description: Officially launching Cal.com Events, Cal.com Discover, Cal.ai Assistant, a new brand and more!

items.name: ChatGPT Wallet
items.tagline: Let ChatGPT agents buy things without seeing your card
items.description: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI's "dots" agents finish purchases for you. The card network gives the agent a payment token, so neither the agent nor the merchant ever sees your card number. You review the items, the total and the card before each purchase, then approve with Face ID or a fingerprint. Built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa.

items.name: Cookie Away
items.tagline: Rejects cookie banners for you, even the sneaky ones
items.description: Cookie Away is a free, open-source Chrome extension that rejects cookie banners for you. No reject button? It opens the settings, switches everything off and saves. It never pays to say no, checks every click, and we published its results on 69 sites.

items.name: Trusty CSV
items.tagline: Edit CSV files like code, not like a spreadsheet
items.description: Data prep without the project, the flow or the script. Open a CSV and work on the file itself: cluster similar values, pivot, join, filter, or just type in a cell. Every step is one Ctrl+Z, and a diff of the saved file shows only what you changed.

items.name: Pharen Hub
items.tagline: One AI workspace for your whole company
items.description: Pharen Hub brings projects, tasks, docs, mail, meetings, data and AI agents into one workspace with one shared context. Agents work with clear goals, allowed sources and human approval. Hosted in the EU or on your own servers. Fair-code, source on GitHub. Free plan to start.

items.name: StateWeave
items.tagline: Test your AI agent on working clones of the apps it uses
items.description: StateWeave runs your AI agent in sandboxes of the apps it works in: stateful clones of Slack, Gmail, Salesforce, Shopify, Zendesk, Google Calendar, Sheets, Drive, WhatsApp and Teams, with the same APIs, MCP servers and UIs as the real thing. Describe a scenario to fill every app with consistent data, inject faults like outages and 401s, and get graded runs showing which checks failed and the exact calls behind them. Fresh copy every run.

items.name: Puffin
items.tagline: Identity and inboxes for AI agents
items.description: Give each AI agent its own email address, a seat in Discord, Slack and Telegram, and a calendar. It replies with built-in AI or your own agent: you approve every message, or let it run on full autopilot.

items.name: Curates
items.tagline: The all-in-one platform for creators
items.description: Curates is where creatives keep, share and show their work. Send clients a review link with comments, approvals and downloads. Add any photo to your portfolio website in two clicks and build a private showcase for every project. No exports, no re-uploads.

items.name: ByteVoice
items.tagline: Talk to your coding agents and hear them back
items.description: Talk to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any agent instead of typing, hear their summaries, and reply directly to agents.

items.name: Flamigo
items.tagline: Turn rough notes into beautifully designed slides
items.description: Paste your notes, review the outline, and let Flamigo design the slides. Compare designs for a slide, then fine-tune its layout in the editor. Start free and export to HTML, or export to PowerPoint with editable text on Pro.

items.name: Blomma for Organizations
items.tagline: Scale your people at the speed of your business
items.description: HR teams are stretched thin, and most people never get a coach. Blomma gives every manager and employee a proactive AI career coach that knows your company, so your people team can scale. • Coaching grounded in your values, competencies and OKRs • 1:1 prep, feedback, hard conversations, reviews and onboarding • Checks in, tracks goals and keeps people accountable • Private by default: admins see only aggregate insights and your conversations always stay private.

items.name: UI SDK by Vercel
items.tagline: Give AI agents the building blocks to create UI
items.description: UI SDK gives AI agents reusable interface behaviors to build custom, accessible UI components. Use one core library across React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components.

items.name: Punchcutter
items.tagline: Turn a sentence or your handwriting into a real font family
items.description: Punchcutter is a free, open-source Agent Skill and MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and Cursor. Describe a typeface or photograph your handwriting and get a real font family: TTF, OTF, variable and webfonts, with its own Studio app.

items.name: Freebuff
items.tagline: The 100% free coding agent
items.description: Code, build and deploy apps, and chat with AI for free. Work in your browser, desktop or terminal with Freebuff.

items.name: Centralize
items.tagline: Relationship Workspace for Enterprise Deal Teams
items.description: Account mapping software that automatically maps stakeholders, identifies buying committee gaps, surfaces warm paths, and recommends next actions for enterprise deals.
